messages:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT PAGE — elevated p99 latency impacting streaming responses on inference path in us-east-1. page sent to @Maya Patel and @Jamal Ortiz. start: 12:03 UTC. symptoms: streaming stalls + partial timeouts for Hosted API tenants.

Maya Patel: acked, I'm on it. first look at p99/p95: p95 ~720ms -> 1.1s, p99 spiking to 6-9s for streaming sessions. non-stream gen endpoints less affected.

Jamal Ortiz: seeing a large increase in config-fetch latencies and a spike in auth tokenstore 5xxs around same time. looks like lots of retries from edge -> token-store DB pool exhaustion maybe. Grafana query: `sum(rate(tokenstore_errors_total[1m])) by (code)` shows 5xx jump at 12:02.

Priya Singh: logs from controlplane-config-fetch:```
2026-03-15T12:02:14Z ERROR fetcher.go:142 fetch failed tenant=acmemedia err="dial tcp: i/o timeout"
2026-03-15T12:02:15Z WARN sync.go:87 retrying featureflag propagation tenant=acmemedia retries=4
```
also seeing `503` proxied from token-store.

Elliot Chen: running quick health checks: token-store pods show 100% CONN_USAGE in psql stat activity. `SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state='active';` returned ~250 (pool limit 250). error rate aligns with connection saturation. suspect retry storm from a newly rolled feature flag causing heavy fanout config requests.

Maya Patel: possible mitigations we can try in parallel:
- enable stale-config fallback to avoid controlplane calls for 30s (`/v1/config/fallback?duration=30s`)
- temporarily increase token-store read pool to 400 (hotfix)
- apply per-tenant throttling for top noisy tenants (AcmeMedia, StreamlyCo)
- revert recent flag change that expanded config fanout (`ff:enable-llm-debugging`)
- route streaming traffic for affected customers to Dedicated pool if available

Jamal Ortiz: I'm going to flip the feature flag rollback and enable stale-config fallback. doing step-by-step:
1) `POST https://controlplane.internal/v1/flags/enable-llm-debugging` body `{ "enabled": false }` -> 12:07 UTC
2) `curl -XPOST https://controlplane.internal/v1/ops/config-fallback -d '{"duration":"30s"}'` -> 12:09 UTC

deploy-bot: rollout started for flag rollback (rollout-id: r-ff-8591). paused after 20% -> waiting watch.

Priya Singh: applying per-tenant rate-limit rule for streaming on the gateway now: `PATCH /v1/gateway/ratelimits` body `{ "tenants": ["acmemedia","streamlyco"], "max_rps": 10 }` -> 12:10 UTC.

Elliot Chen: scaling token-store deployment: `kubectl scale deploy token-store -n infra --replicas=4` -> 12:11 UTC. psql pool bump scheduled as DB config change (rolling restart) will take ~3 minutes.

Maya Patel: monitoring p99 after the interventions. initial sign of improvement at 12:14 UTC: p99 dropped from ~8s to ~2.2s, streaming stalls reduced but not fully resolved. keep on watcher.

CustomerSuccessBot: Notified CS reps for AcmeMedia and StreamlyCo at 12:12 UTC. CS advised to open high-touch channels. partial streaming outages for ~15% of sessions for those tenants.

Jamal Ortiz: observing a remaining tail caused by a small subset of requests that still hit a cold config path. adding a temporary cache warmup for hot tenants: `POST /internal/warmup?tenant=acmemedia&paths=/config` -> 12:16 UTC.

Maya Patel: after warmup and scale, p95~600ms, p99~1.1s across region; streaming stalls nearly resolved. marking incident as mitigated at 12:20 UTC.

oncall-bot: HANDOFF planned — Maya will remain on-page for next 30m to ensure stability. Jamal to pick up postmortem notes. please add any follow-ups.

Elliot Chen: follow-ups I'm adding:
- postmortem to capture root cause (feature flag fanout + token-store pool config), timeline, and test for flag rollouts that increase config fanout.
- add guardrails to reject >X config requests/s per tenant.
- revisit DB pool sizing and implement circuit-breaker on controlplane config fetch.

Maya Patel: noted. tagging `postmortem` and `oncall` channels. will schedule 1-hour follow-up at 15:00 UTC. thanks all. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: rollout `r-ff-8591` completed (rollback fully applied) at 12:18 UTC.

oncall-bot: Incident status -> MITIGATED. Continue observation for 1h. create postmortem and link to this thread when ready.
summary: Live triage for inference-path latency spike caused by feature-flag-driven config-fetch fanout -> token-store DB pool exhaustion; mitigations: flag rollback, stale-config fallback, per-tenant throttling, token-store scale, cache warmup; mitigated in ~17 minutes.
